rule: AMENDED 2026-11-08 before any judging (original: sha1 order, first 4 tasks dev, 1 dev failure in 28 attempts). Stratified by task: tasks with >=1 held-out failure in any attempt vs none; within each stratum sha1('jev-judge-split:'+task) ascending; dev = first 2 failing-stratum + first 2 passing-stratum tasks, rest test.

original.rule: sha1('jev-judge-split:'+task) ascending; first 4 = dev (~30% of 14 tasks), rest = test. Split by TASK so replicates and arms of one task never straddle.
